name: David Fifield
biography: is the co-maintainer of Nmap and author of the Ndiff scan comparison utility. He has also been active in the maintenance and enhancement of the Ncat network tool, the Zenmap GUI, and the Nmap Scripting Engine. Much of his time has been spent improving Nmap's performance and accuracy. He has previously presented about Nmap at the FOSDEM and LinuxTag conferences.
